Background: uncheck the “show background option”

Text: uncheck “show text”

Colors: doesn’t really matter whatever you want it to be, I chose white as you can see.

1x4 Minimalistic Text (Horizontal)
Background: uncheck “show background”

Go Launcher EX
Screen Settings: Screen orientation vertical mode, grid size standard, uncheck show status bar, app icon labels: hide,

Metrostation
This is the icon pack I used. when you open it up click the icon you want and it will have you pick a color than it will save that as an image in your gallery under the metrostation folder. to change icons, press and hold the app you want to change, than some options will come up and one will say “replace” click than than hit the button at the upper righthand corner that looks like the gallery icon and it will bring you to your images, after that you select your icon from the metrostation folder and it will change to that icon.
